messages:
maria-cs: Heads up — Platina is showing an embed-heavy usage spike this week. I'm pulling numbers for the QBR cost slide and want a quick sync on token economics + renewal risk.
kevin-csm: Thanks Maria. Is this across prod only or also staging?
maria-cs: Prod only. Mostly a new feature rollout they did on Tuesday. We saw a 3.8x jump in embedding units/day.
pranav-finops: I can run the forecast and flag thresholds. If we assume current pace holds, monthly spend projects +86% vs last month.
jess-onboard: Are they still in the 30-day onboarding window? I thought we had an enablement session scheduled last week.
maria-cs: They finished onboarding 2 weeks ago but asked for extra embed tuning help — that might explain the surge.
billing-bot: Alert: account=platina, rule=embed_units_monthly, current=1,240,000, threshold=1,000,000, status=triggered
sam-analytics: Quick query I ran — here's the rolling-7 usage split by route: 
```sql
SELECT route, sum(embed_units) as units
FROM usage_events
WHERE account = 'platina' AND ts > now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY units DESC;
```
sam-analytics: Top routes are `/api/embeds/bulk` (67%) and `/v1/embeds/stream` (18%).
pranav-finops: Action: I'll produce a 90-day spend forecast with two scenarios (current growth, throttled-by-20%). ETA EOD tomorrow.
kevin-csm: For renewal risk: finance + onboarding notes — if spend surprises the customer they might push the renewal. Maria, can we confirm whether they expected this usage in their forecast?
maria-cs: I checked the kickoff doc — customer expected light embed experimentation only, not heavy production traffic. They didn't add a committed capacity line item.
jess-onboard: I'll schedule a technical enablement today to look at prefix caching and batched requests. Might cut units by ~30% for their current pattern.
emma-ops: FYI we can add a temporary budget alert tier for them (notify at 60/80/100%) so PMs and engineering get proactive notices.
kevin-csm: Good call. Pranav, can you add a recommended quota guardrail in the forecast?
pranav-finops: Yep — I'll include a suggested burst cap + cost control plan and quick ops playbook for them.
maria-cs: Great. For the QBR deck I'll include: one-slide spend trend, forecast scenarios, enablement plan, and renewal risk mitigation.
kevin-csm: Assign owners: Forecast = @pranav-finops, Enablement + savings estimate = @jess-onboard, Alerts + ops = @emma-ops, Deck slide = @maria-cs.
maria-cs: Sounds good. One more ask — capture customer feedback on model latency and embed quality for the QBR. Any recent notes?
sam-analytics: Sent a short survey to their engineering lead this morning, awaiting reply. Will paste feedback here when it arrives.
pranav-finops: I'll drop the forecast into the shared drive and ping for review when done. Link in thread when uploaded.
maria-cs: Thanks everyone — let's reconvene tomorrow after Pranav posts the numbers. :thumbsup:
